_comment: Studio — three-pane layout: main chat (40%) + visual pane (40%) + Aside (20%). The visual pane is bridged to the main chat and renders ora-visual artifacts from the primary conversation; per plan §2 it is collapsible to 0% but not removable. Aside is an independent, non-persisted conversation with a dedicated model preference in General settings and a five-turn in-memory context window. The legacy default_bucket field below is retained only for layout-schema compatibility and is not the live V3 Aside routing source. Replaces the prior two-pane studio (main + sidebar) preserved at layouts/legacy/studio.workbench-era.json.
